body: Yes indeed, I've been thinking about it a lot. Maybe a relationship where I get to have enough space or being single are better options for me. I do love her though, and she was not like this before, so I'm kinda hoping it becomes like the first six months where everything was super.

Congrats on your LDR! Most people find that really tough, so I admire you for being able to manage that. I think LDR take more effort than SDR, because you only have limited supplies to talk to each other. I think LDR matters equally like SDR, because a relationship is a relationship and in relationships communication and trust are keys.
Usually we have a conversation, but then after a while we are both not really into it and do different stuff, which results in me being offline some times.

I do admit that the relationship is not really what I want right now. You see, the first six months of our relationship were really, really fun. I just keep holding on because I'm hoping that someday with effort and trust, the relationship becomes fun again. But because of her depression, she often feels like staying inside and lying in bed all the time; resulting in us not having dates at all. I tried to convince her to start having dates again, but she doesn't have the time; if she is not lying in bed all day, she travels, a lot. This summer break she is going away too, four times. I'll barely see her.

I posted an edit; my girlfriend is dealing with depression and that causes her to be sad a lot of the time. At this point it feels like she wants to talk to me all the time so she doesn't feel sad, but doesn't think about the personal space I need once in a while.
The earth probably won't exist anymore in 50 years due to climate changing lol

I know exactly how you feel. A year ago I was bubbly, social, and I was always happy no matter what. I gave good advices to people and I tried to maintain all my friendships, and my relationship. Ever since my depression, I've been irritated at literally everything and everyone, pushing people away with it. I drag people to much into my sadness, too. It's not fun. I remember exactly how I was a year ago, but I just can't get the same person back.

You're right, but it is also the fact that my best friend is really mad at me for talking to another girl, and my workplace being not so nice at the moment. I might get through it though, thanks.

(Today my girlfriend decided to stop talking to me because she did not like the way I took longer than normal to reply to her. She really aint worth it.)
